secondary.name: React Bits SideRays and SoftAurora
secondary.licenseObligations: Retain the 2026 David Haz copyright, permission notice, Commons Clause restriction, and warranty disclaimer. Do not sell or redistribute the adapted components alone, bundled, or as a ported component library.
secondary.modificationSummary: Port the supplied React shaders into two framework-native Astro components, retain OGL only, extend the SideRays source into the hero, add theme-specific orange and blue ray colors with clamped shader output, use orange and blue SoftAurora colors, remove all mouse interaction, and add reduced-motion, visibility, resize, theme, and WebGL cleanup handling.
secondary.contributionBoundary: Decorative SideRays behind the hero and SoftAurora at the Work-to-Profile transition only. No React runtime, component API, router, content system, or styling foundation is adopted.

requiredApprovals: Use the user-supplied SideRays character in the hero, with an extended source and theme-specific color correction for visibility in dark and light modes.
Move the original SoftAurora effect to immediately before Profile without mouse interaction.
conflicts: React is not introduced; both effects remain Astro-native OGL components.
The two effects do not overlap, add page height, intercept pointer input, or replace existing theme and content foundations.
The adapted components remain inseparable parts of this portfolio application and are not offered as a standalone component product.
remainingUncertainty: Physical-device GPU rendering remains subject to the user's final phone review.
